checkedAlternates.risk: Port is a vessel reference term like Bow and Stern.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Port and Starboard are lateral left/right directions (group-4), whereas Bow, Stern, and Amidships mark fore-to-aft hull positions (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: A lighthouse is an aid to navigation like buoys.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Lighthouses are fixed coastal structures (group-1), distinct from floating buoys (group-2).
